Count the triples of positions i<j<k whose values form the pattern 312 (π(i) largest, π(j) smallest, π(k) in the middle).

For each triple of positions, the relative order of the three values is equally likely to be any of the 3! = 6 patterns, and exactly one of these patterns is the required one (π(j) < π(k) < π(i)).

The number of rotated cycles over all permutations is therefore

C(10,3) · 10! / 6 = 120 · 3628800 / 6 = 20 · 3628800 = 72,576,000.

ANSWER: 72576000
